sourceRef: IsaFlow-Xero-Comparison-20261023/sage-payroll/01-paye-reconciliation.md: Sage Payroll demo company, payslips and "View Tax Calculation" observed 2026-10-24 (tax year 2027, March 2026 monthly period)
notes: Sage excludes an independent contractor from PAYE, UIF and SDL. This fixture costs the person with the default employee set-up (UIF and SDL on), which is what the calculator does when nobody sets the contractor up; sage-2027-03-rassie-contractor-setup costs the same pay set up as a contractor and matches Sage. Sage demo employee "rassie" (a Sage demo record, not a real person). Sage tax status: independent_contractor. Sage shows age 43 only; the date of birth is set to 1 January 1983 (year only kept). No case is near 65 (rebates) or 18-29 (ETI). Net is not on the Sage table: it is monthly pay less the Sage PAYE and employee UIF (no other deductions). ETI: nil by ETI Act s6(a), age outside 18-29.
